name: Chao cau gai
summary: Sea-urchin porridge made only with fresh urchin: the meat and roe are seasoned, stir-fried, and poured into boiling rice.
howToEat: Eat it once the rice has opened.
seoTitle: Chao cau gai — Quy Nhon sea-urchin porridge
seoDescription: Quy Nhon cháo cầu gai is fresh sea urchin, meat and roe, seasoned, stir-fried, and stirred into boiling rice porridge.
